name: Octopus Countertop Blender
shortDescription: A powerful blender for smoothies, soups and crushed ice.
description: The Octopus Countertop Blender has the power for daily smoothies and tougher jobs alike. A 1500W motor and seven presets handle most of the work, and a one-touch clean cycle rinses the jug so you don't have to.

image.alt: The Octopus Countertop Blender in black

features.title: Powers through the tough stuff
features.description: A 1500W motor lets you do anything from crushing ice to blending smoothies

features.title: Skip the scrubbing
features.description: Add water and a little detergent, press clean, and the blender cleans itself

features.title: Control in short bursts
features.description: The pulse function runs the blades in bursts, giving you even more control

features.title: A preset for the everyday
features.description: Seven intelligent presets for smoothies, soups, purées & more

image.alt: The Octopus Countertop Blender, seen from the front

seo.title: Octopus Countertop Blender | 1500W blender with seven presets
seo.description: Smoothies, soups and crushed ice with a 1500W motor and seven presets. The Octopus Countertop Blender rinses its own jug in one touch.

image.alt: The Octopus Countertop Blender in black

name: Octopus Air Fryer 5.7 L
shortDescription: A 5.7 L air fryer that cooks meals quickly and evenly, with 2200W and dual heaters
description: The Octopus Air Fryer 5.7 L cooks meals for the whole family with little to no oil. Its 2200W element and dual heaters cook quickly and evenly, so food comes out crisp all over.

name: Octopus Indoor Camera
shortDescription: A 2K indoor camera that pans to cover the whole room and tracks movement as it happens
description: The Octopus Indoor Camera records in 2K and pans to cover the whole room. When something moves, the camera follows it as it happens.

name: Octopus Ionic Hair Dryer
shortDescription: An ionic hair dryer with a 110,000 RPM motor for fast drying and less frizz
description: The Octopus Ionic Hair Dryer pairs a 110,000 RPM motor with ionic care. It dries hair fast and leaves it smoother, with less frizz.

name: Octopus Blender
shortDescription: A 300W personal blender that blends straight into a cup you can take with you
description: The Octopus Blender blends on 300W straight into the cup you drink from. Blend your smoothie, then take the cup with you.

name: Octopus Kettle
shortDescription: A 1.7 L kettle that boils fast on 1800W, with a body that stays cool to the touch
description: The Octopus Kettle boils up to 1.7 L on 1800W. Its body stays cool to the touch, even right after it boils.

name: Octopus Outdoor Camera
shortDescription: An outdoor camera that runs on solar power and records in 3K
description: The Octopus Outdoor Camera records in 3K and runs on solar power, so it keeps watching without a cable to run to it.

name: Octopus Video Doorbell
shortDescription: A 2K video doorbell that lets you answer from your phone
description: The Octopus Video Doorbell shows who is at the door in 2K. Answer them from your phone, wherever you are.

name: Octopus Power Bank 10,000 mAh
shortDescription: A slim power bank with the USB-C cable already built in
description: The Octopus Power Bank holds 10,000 mAh in a slim case. Its USB-C cable is built in, so there is no cable to forget.

name: Octopus Power Board with USB Charging
shortDescription: A compact power board with four sockets and four USB ports
description: The Octopus Power Board with USB Charging fits four sockets and four USB ports in one compact board, for your plugs and your phones alike.

name: Octopus 3-in-1 Magnetic Charging Station
shortDescription: A Qi2 stand that charges your phone, watch and earbuds at the same time
description: The Octopus 3-in-1 Magnetic Charging Station is a Qi2 stand that charges your phone, watch and earbuds at the same time, with your phone held in place by magnets.
